resource_warning.label: Sonic Analysis is powerful but resource-intensive: it loads a machine-learning model (CLAP) into memory to analyze how your music sounds. The minimum requirements are 4 GB of RAM, 2 CPU cores and SIMD acceleration (AVX2 on Intel/AMD CPUs, NEON on ARM). For the best experience we recommend 6 GB or more of RAM and 4 CPU cores. On systems near the minimum, or under heavy load, you may still run into out-of-memory situations.

clap_sampling.label: CLAP quality (windows per track)
clap_sampling.description: Number of 7-second windows CLAP analyzes per track. More windows produce more representative scalars at linear CPU cost. Thorough is most useful for instrumentalness, where vocals can be missed by a single window.

option_descriptions.fast: One window per track — lowest CPU. Fine for a quick first pass over a large library.
option_descriptions.balanced: Three windows — the recommended default; good accuracy at moderate CPU cost.
option_descriptions.thorough: Eight windows — highest accuracy at the highest CPU cost.

errors.model_assets_downloading: Sonic Analysis is still downloading its machine-learning model (about 700 MB). This only happens once and the download keeps running in the background. If Sonic Analysis is still listed in your providers it will start on its own once the download finishes; if it is not, add it again at that point.
errors.model_assets_download_failed: Sonic Analysis could not download its machine-learning model. Check this server's internet connection and available disk space. If Sonic Analysis is still listed in your providers it will try again on its own; if it is not, add it again to retry.
errors.prompt_embeddings_unavailable: Sonic Analysis is missing the precomputed prompt data it needs to score tracks, which means this installation is incomplete.

manifest.description: Analyses how each track sounds to power similarity, mood-based playlists, and other audio-aware features.
